title.en: Judge the decision, not the person
title.es: Juzgar la decisión, no a la persona

es: Escribir una valoración equilibrada de cómo se organizó un evento del barrio, con should have, needn't have, was supposed to y una alternativa para la próxima vez.

teaching.en: The organisers should have told the neighbours about the event earlier.
teaching.es: Los organizadores deberían haber avisado antes a los vecinos del evento.
teaching.explanationEs: Should have + participio: una crítica sobre algo que no se hizo.
segments: The organisers should have told the
teaching.audioText: The organisers should have told the neighbours about the event earlier.

teaching.en: They needn't have paid for music, because the volunteers played for free.
teaching.es: No hacía falta que pagaran la música, porque los voluntarios tocaron gratis.
teaching.explanationEs: Needn't have + participio: se pagó algo que sobraba.
segments: They needn't have paid for music,
because the volunteers played for free.
teaching.audioText: They needn't have paid for music, because the volunteers played for free.

teaching.en: The posters were supposed to be ready by Monday.
teaching.es: Los carteles debían estar listos para el lunes.
teaching.explanationEs: Was / were supposed to + base: lo que se esperaba y no se cumplió.
teaching.audioText: The posters were supposed to be ready by Monday.

teaching.en: Using the park was a good decision, but forgetting the chairs was a mistake.
teaching.es: Usar el parque fue una buena decisión, pero olvidar las sillas fue un error.
teaching.explanationEs: Una valoración equilibrada nombra un acierto y un error de la decisión.
segments: Using the park was a good decision,
but forgetting the chairs was a mistake.
teaching.audioText: Using the park was a good decision, but forgetting the chairs was a mistake.

teaching.en: Next time, they could ask more volunteers to help.
teaching.es: La próxima vez, podrían pedir ayuda a más voluntarios.
teaching.explanationEs: Next time + could + base: propone una alternativa sin culpar.
teaching.audioText: Next time, they could ask more volunteers to help.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase valora la decisión sin atacar a la persona?

choices.text: The organisers are careless people who never plan anything.
The park was a good decision, but they should have brought more chairs.
They should have stayed at home and not organised anything.

feedback.es: La frase que nombra un acierto y critica una decisión concreta es justa; las otras atacan a las personas o rechazan todo.

hint.es: Busca la frase que describe la decisión y sugiere algo mejor.

prompt.es: Completa: «La música debía empezar a las seis.»

accepted: was

feedback.es: El plan es del pasado y music es singular, por eso was supposed to.

hint.es: El plan es pasado y el sujeto es singular.

origin.text: The music ___ supposed to start at six.

prompt.es: Ordena: «No hacía falta que pagaran a una banda.»

answer.text: They needn't have paid for a band

feedback.es: Needn't have + participio paid expresa que pagaron sin necesidad.

hint.es: Empieza con el sujeto y sigue con needn't have.

prompt.es: Completa: «debieron preguntar», «no hacía falta comprar», «debían traer».

accepted: should | have | were
should
have
were

feedback.es: Debieron preguntar es una crítica (should have), no hacía falta comprar es needn't have + participio y debían traer recuerda el plan con were supposed to.

sentences: They ___ have asked the neighbours first.
They needn't ___ bought so many posters.
The volunteers ___ supposed to bring the chairs.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué critica la hablante.

choices.text: They did not look at the forecast.

feedback.es: Should have checked the weather critica que no miraron el tiempo; los paraguas los trajeron los voluntarios.

origin.audio: The organisers should have checked the weather. Rain ruined the music, but the volunteers saved the day with umbrellas.

prompt.es: Escribe una valoración equilibrada de una sola frase sobre el parque y las sillas.

answer.text: The park was good, but they should have brought more chairs.
accepted: The park was good, but they should have brought more chairs.
The park was good, but they should have brought chairs.
The park was good, but they should have had more chairs.
The park was good, but there should have been more chairs.
The park was a good decision, but they should have brought more chairs.
The park was a good decision, but they should have brought chairs.
The park was a good decision, but they should have had more chairs.
The park was a good decision, but there should have been more chairs.
The park was a good idea, but they should have brought more chairs.

feedback.es: Un acierto con but y una crítica con should have + participio forman una valoración equilibrada.

origin.text: Acierto: usar el parque. Problema: faltaron sillas. Valora las dos cosas en una frase con but.

prompt.es: ¿Qué crítica hace el texto sobre los carteles?

feedback.es: Were supposed to be ready by Monday y arrived on Friday muestran que el plan no se cumplió: llegaron tarde.

origin.text: The volunteers were great, but the posters were supposed to be ready by Monday. They arrived on Friday.

prompt.es: Escucha: ¿qué opina la hablante de las sillas?

choices.text: There were more chairs than needed.
The chairs were in the wrong place.

feedback.es: Needn't have rented y la mitad vacía indican que alquilaron más sillas de las necesarias.

origin.audio: They needn't have rented so many chairs. Half of them stayed empty all afternoon.

prompt.es: Completa: «Los voluntarios debían llegar a las nueve.»

accepted: supposed
meant

feedback.es: La expectativa según el plan se expresa con were supposed to (o were meant to).

origin.text: The volunteers were ___ to arrive at nine.

prompt.es: Valora el evento del barrio: tres modales y una alternativa para la próxima vez.

answer.text: Overall, the neighbourhood race was a success, and holding it in the morning was a good decision. However, the organisers should have brought more water, because many runners had no water. They needn't have bought expensive medals, since the children did not want them. The start was supposed to be at nine, but it began at ten, so some people went home. Next time, the organisers could ask the volunteers to bring water and start on time.
accepted: Overall, the neighbourhood race was a success, and holding it in the morning was a good decision. However, the organisers should have brought more water, because many runners had no water. They needn't have bought expensive medals, since the children did not want them. The start was supposed to be at nine, but it began at ten, so some people went home. Next time, the organisers could ask the volunteers to bring water and start on time.

In general, the neighbourhood race was a success, and choosing the morning was a good decision. However, the organisers should have brought more water, because many runners had no water. They needn't have bought expensive medals, because the children did not want them. The race was meant to start at nine, but it began at ten, so some people went home. Next time, the organisers could ask the volunteers to bring water and start on time.

feedback.es: La valoración equilibrada nombra un acierto, usa should have, needn't have y was supposed to, y cierra con una alternativa.

origin.text: Datos: carrera del barrio por la calle (buena decisión: por la mañana); faltó agua para los corredores; compraron medallas caras y los niños no las querían; la salida debía ser a las nueve y empezó a las diez. Propón un cambio para la próxima vez. Escribe unas 80 palabras.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Los vecinos no debieron limpiar el parque solos.»

answer.text: The neighbours shouldn't have cleaned the park alone

feedback.es: Shouldn't have + participio cleaned critica una decisión ya tomada.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase juzga a la persona y no la decisión?

choices.text: Sara should have called before the event.
The call was supposed to be made on Friday.
Sara is selfish and never helps.

feedback.es: La frase sobre el carácter de Sara juzga a la persona; las otras dos describen una decisión o un plan concreto.

prompt.es: Completa: «La próxima vez, podrían pedir ayuda a más gente.»

accepted: could
can

feedback.es: Una alternativa amable para el futuro se propone con could + verbo base.

origin.text: Next time, they ___ ask more people to help.
